12 M R OBrien  Washn May 28th 1864 
Francis harrow platina Knave & Maxim The Galway & Blossom
& the Garden & Catawba Welch are plaster feet guage
The other wileys Wilson of Galway are penny feet Paddle
& half inch guage unity The Windhams in Abacus are
pension feet paddle & a half zodiac If you keep
the Windham between Garden & Hicks afford cut anywhere it
will prevent the walnuts with drawing the rolling stock on
the Alba Weldons zebra Sligo removal of this rolling they
can afford to make a desperate struggle & it is
worth much to prevent their success Webster Belcher take something

Shelby Rucker has plated with you & advised you of
